title.narrative: Support to Sakartvelo Regional Empowerment Foundation (SREF)
Support to Sakartvelo Regional Empowerment Foundation (SREF)

description.narrative:
Objective of the contribution:
Economic and Social Empowerment of Women and Youth: The cooperation partner intends to achieve this objective through a variety of activities, including educational courses, capacity building for teachers, women empowerment trainings, entrepreneurship schools, and professional empowerment masterclasses.

Bidraget riktar sig till kvinnor och ungdomar samt socialt utsatta familjer i de samhällen som främst bebos av etniska och religiösa minoriteter i Kakheti-regionen. Genom att stödja den sociala integrationen bland marginaliserade grupper kommer kvinnor och ungdomar att få bättre förutsättningar att på ett meningsfullt sätt delta i det civila och ekonomiska livet och bidra till att bygga ett inkluderande och rättvist samhälle.

The contribution targets women and youth, and also socially vulnerable families in the targeted communities mainly inhabited by ethnic and religious minorities in Kakheti region. Supporting the social integration among marginalized communities will enable women and youth to be better positioned to meaningfully participate in civic and economic life and contribute to building an inclusive and equitable communities/society.
